name: Rwanda
dated: Law Nº 027/2022 of 20/10/2022 on income taxes, as amended by Law Nº 051/2023 of 05/09/2023 and Law Nº 014/2025 of 27/05/2025
sources: Sources: Official Gazette texts (trilingual) in `cmp20/world/B10-anglophone-africa/rw/law/` (law027_2022.txt, law051_2023.txt, law014_2025.txt). Third pass: VAT Law 049/2023 and Excise Law 011/2025 fetched from apis.amategeko.gov.rw (documents-files/4497, /10055).

vat.name: Value Added Tax
vat.statute: Law Nº 049/2023 of 05/09/2023 art. 4 (b) (18 %); Law Nº 009/2025 of 27/05/2025 does not change the rate
vat.doc: Law 049/2023 art. 4: "... (b) or 18% for other goods and services supplied in Rwanda" (zero-rated and exempt supplies under the Law). Official gazette PDFs fetched from the amategeko.gov.rw API (`R4/rw/law/fetch/`, SHA256SUMS).
notes: VAT 18 %; zero-rated and exempt supplies (Law 049/2023 annexes) not separated from the basket lines

excise.name: Excise duty
excise.statute: Law Nº 011/2025 of 27/05/2025 art. 4 and annex (in force on publication; Law Nº 050/2023 before), art. 6 (b) (base: selling price)
excise.doc: Law 011/2025 annex: "Beer whose local raw material content, excluding water, is at least 70% ... 40% ... Other beers 65% ... Wine whose local raw material content ... 40% ... Other wines 70% of the value of a litre not exceeding FRW 40,000 ... Lemonade, soda ... 39%"; art. 6 (b): "the tax base for a product manufactured in Rwanda ... is the selling price of the product" (taken as the value before excise and VAT). Grade B: in force from its publication (mid-2025; Law 050/2023 applied before) and the selling-price base read as the pre-tax value.
notes: Law 011/2025: beer and wine with at least 70 % local raw material are at 40 % (not separable); spirits, tobacco, fuel and the pre-publication Law 050/2023 rates not modelled
unsupported: Law 050/2023 for the months before publication

cit.name: Corporate income tax
cit.statute: Law 027/2022 art. 48 (1) as amended by Law 051/2023 (28 %, rounded down to FRW 1 000)
cit.doc: Law 051/2023 amending art. 48 (1): "Taxable Business profit is rounded down to the nearest 1000 Rwandan Francs and taxable at a rate of 28%" (the 2022 text said thirty percent). Law 014/2025 amends the capital gains rate (10 %) and gaming, not art. 48.
notes: Law 027/2022 art. 48: reduced rates for newly listed companies and incentive regimes not applied

wht.name: Withholding tax (art. 60)
wht.doc: art. 60: "A withholding tax of fifteen percent (15%) of the total amount excluding value added tax … is levied on payments made by resident persons"; payments subject to it: "1° dividends …", interest, royalties, service fees (5 % for listed securities' dividends and interest).
